children.name: Dietes
children.description: Dietes — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Dietes iridioides
children.description: Dietes iridioides, commonly named African iris, fortnight lily, and morea iris, is a species of plant in the family Iridaceae that is native to Southern Africa.

children.name: Dietes bicolor
children.description: Dietes bicolor, the African iris, butterfly flag, fortnight lily, or peacock flower, is a clump-forming rhizomatous perennial plant with long sword-like evergreen pale green leaves, growing from multiple fans at the base of the clump.

children.name: Dietes grandiflora
children.description: Dietes grandiflora, commonly named fortnight lily, large wild iris, African iris or fairy iris, is a rhizomatous perennial plant of the Iris Family (Iridaceae) with long, rigid, sword-like green leaves.

children.name: Dietes robinsoniana
children.description: Dietes robinsoniana, the Lord Howe wedding lily, is found naturally only on Lord Howe Island, Australia.

children.name: Dietes butcheriana
children.description: Dietes butcheriana is a small shrub and geophyte.

children.name: Dietes flavida
children.description: Dietes flavida is a small shrub and geophyte that flowers from October to January.
